shortDesc: Modern C++ cryptography library with a Python extension — password hashing, file encryption, byte-level ciphers.
fullDesc:
A cryptography library built in modern C++ and exposed as a Python extension via pybind11. It implements custom cryptographic ciphers and memory-hard hashing algorithms from scratch, without external dependencies like OpenSSL.

Core Idea:
The project focuses on custom security algorithms for learning and experimentation:
• SecureHash — a memory-hard password hashing function designed to resist GPU-based parallel brute-force attacks.
• FileCipher — a symmetric block-level encryption algorithm applying dynamic bit-rotation and XOR chaining on byte streams.
• ByteCrypt — high-speed, in-memory byte-stream encryption exposed to Python via pybind11 bindings.

It features a full documentation site and an interactive Streamlit application to demonstrate the encryption live.
